scope: Clio document management (folders, versions, categories, Clio Drive, OCR/search, templates, automation), Clio Draft (court forms, Canada), e-signature, document sharing; compared with legal-spec/documents.json. Method: official help-article bodies via the help.clio.com Zendesk help-center API (direct pages and Wayback returned 403/blocked); clio.com pages via search snippets only.

features.name: Documents home navigation
features.where: Documents (left nav): New, Recents, Starred, Private, Firm, Contacts, Matters, Trash, Settings
features.what: One store grouped by matter and contact, plus firm-level (non-matter) files, a per-user private area, recents and starred items.
features.plan_tier: select plans (help says 'available to select plans'; tier not named)

features.name: List / tree view, sort and visible columns
features.where: Documents > Firm|Contacts|Matters > View as / Sort by / Visible columns
features.what: Tree view shows the full matter folder structure; user picks and orders columns (latest version, owner, size, status, ID, category, received at, author, recorded time, etc.).
features.plan_tier: select plans (help says 'available to select plans'; tier not named)

features.name: Folders and folder upload
features.where: Documents > + New > Create a new folder / Upload a folder
features.what: Create or upload folders (5 GB max per upload) with optional category; contact and matter root folders cannot be moved; only empty folders can be deleted.

features.name: Document metadata: status, classification, category, tags, author, received date
features.where: Document > Actions > Edit details; preview Details panel
features.what: Each file carries a status (e.g. Draft, In review), a legal-document classification (e.g. Affidavit, Complaint), firm category, up to 10 tags, author and received-at date.
features.plan_tier: select plans (help says 'available to select plans'; tier not named)

features.name: Document categories
features.where: Documents > Categories and templates > Categories
features.what: Firm-defined categories used to sort and filter documents and templates.

features.name: Filters and saved views
features.where: Documents > filters > + Create view
features.what: Filter by name, type, status, classification, uploader, tags, category; save filter sets as named views shown as tabs; rename, duplicate, delete views.
features.plan_tier: select plans (help says 'available to select plans'; tier not named)

features.name: Version history
features.where: Document > Versions tab (+ next to Version history)
features.what: Upload a new version, see prior versions, download any earlier version. API exposes /documents/:id/versions.

features.name: Document lock
features.where: Documents > Actions (more) > Lock / Unlock
features.what: Anyone can lock a file to signal they are editing it; only firm administrators can unlock. Padlock icon and a note on the Versions tab.
features.plan_tier: select plans (help says 'available to select plans'; tier not named)

features.name: Preview panel with Details, Versions, Comments, History tabs
features.where: Documents > click file name
features.what: Read without downloading; step through files with arrows; comment thread per file; Word-embedded comments shown separately; activity history tab; print.
features.plan_tier: select plans (help says 'available to select plans'; tier not named)

features.name: Copy a file
features.where: Documents > Actions > Create or generate > Create a copy
features.what: Duplicates content and metadata into a chosen location; audit, version, sharing and e-sign history are not copied; medical records cannot be copied.

features.name: Move single / bulk
features.where: Documents > Actions > Move to; checkbox bulk move
features.what: Move files and folders individually or in bulk.

features.name: Add time from a document
features.where: Documents > Actions > Add time
features.what: Create a time entry directly from a document row.

features.name: Full-text search (AI-dependent)
features.where: Global search bar (Cmd/Ctrl+K) and Documents search field
features.what: Global search matches names and full-text content; if the firm opts out of AI features, search falls back to names and metadata only. Local Documents search is by name.
features.plan_tier: unclear; content search tied to AI features being on

features.name: OCR of scanned files
features.where: not documented
features.what: No help article found describing OCR of image-only PDFs in Manage. Mobile scanner produces PDFs; Clio Work/Vincent accepts images and audio but OCR is not described for Manage search.

features.name: Download file, folder (.zip), bulk, previous version
features.where: Documents > Actions > Download latest / Download folder; bulk download icon
features.what: Original format for files; zip for folders and bulk selections.

features.name: Trash with 30-day restore
features.where: Documents > Trash
features.what: Deleted items go to Trash for 30 days, restorable; permanent delete per item or Empty Trash removes item and its version history.

features.name: Create PDF from Word
features.where: Documents > Download arrow > Create PDF
features.what: Converts a Word file to a PDF in the same folder, e.g. before e-sign.

features.name: Combine files into one PDF
features.where: Matter > Documents > select > Actions > Combine files
features.what: Merge DOCX, PNG, PDF and others into one PDF in a chosen order; optional text edit before saving.

features.name: PDF bundle (cover, TOC, page numbers, matter footer)
features.where: Combine files > Include options
features.what: Bundle adds cover page (title, code, date), clickable table of contents, page numbering and a matter-number footer automatically.
features.plan_tier: 'Premium and higher plans' per help (plan name not confirmed elsewhere)

features.name: In-browser Document Editor with AI
features.where: Documents > Open in > Document Editor; Work > Editor
features.what: Web word processor; Vincent AI can draft from matter context, summarize, rewrite, with Tracked Changes or Direct Edits; auto-saves to matter with version history; reduced toolbar for PDFs.

features.name: Clio Drive virtual drive
features.where: Documents > Desktop access > install; Desktop app > Drive
features.what: Mounts Clio documents as a drive in Finder/Explorer (contacts > matters folders); two-way sync; bulk upload queue; 5 GB file limit; long names shortened; Manage is source of truth on conflict.

features.name: Clio Launcher
features.where: Document > Open in local app
features.what: Opens a Clio file in a chosen desktop program and saves changes back.

features.name: Document templates with merge fields (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF)
features.where: Settings > Documents > Document templates; merge fields at Settings > Documents > Document Template Merge Fields
features.what: <<Matter.Client.Name>> style merge fields; preview field values against a chosen matter; fillable-PDF templates use field names; custom fields usable.

features.name: Generate document from template
features.where: Documents > + New > Create a new document from template
features.what: Choose template, matter, name, output PDF/Word/both; pick which client fills fields on multi-client matters; PI matters can pick contact.

features.name: Automated workflows: generate document on matter created / stage change
features.where: Settings > Automated Workflows > Made by Clio
features.what: Rules (practice area, responsible attorney, from/to stage) that generate a document from a template, assign a task list, or apply a matter template; up to 1,000 automations per firm.
features.plan_tier: select plans (help says 'available to select plans'; tier not named)

features.name: Clio Draft court form library
features.where: Clio Draft > Library > Court forms
features.what: Fillable official court forms auto-filled from Clio Manage matter data; search by form number/title; Request a form if missing. Canada: Ontario and BC forms named in one article, only BC in another; launch press says doc automation works in all provinces except Quebec and data is hosted in Canada.
features.plan_tier: Clio Draft subscription (add-on; per-seat; products selectable)

features.name: Form templates (pre-filled court forms)
features.where: Library > Court forms > Actions > Create form template
features.what: Save a court form with firm-wide pre-filled values and extra text boxes; not auto-updated when the official form changes.

features.name: Sets of forms/templates
features.where: Library > Sets
features.what: Reusable bundles of up to 20 court forms, form templates and Word templates per practice area; drafted together with one populate page.

features.name: Draft workflow: select, populate once, review, regenerate
features.where: Library > Add > Draft new documents; or Manage matter > Documents > New > Create document in Clio Draft
features.what: Answer case facts once to fill all selected documents; review/edit; save to Manage matter; regenerate after data changes.

features.name: Word template builder add-in (cards, fields, conditions)
features.where: Word > Home > Clio Draft Template Builder (or Clio for Word)
features.what: Role cards (parties, courts) and other cards hold fields (short/long text, single/multi select, date); standalone question conditions and field-triggered conditions with AND/OR.

features.name: AI convert document to template
features.where: Draft > Word templates > Create templates from documents; Work Editor > Convert to template
features.what: AI detects fields and conditional sections in .docx (5 files, 5 MB each in Draft); statuses Needs Review / In progress / Ready; Vincent walks the user through proposed fields and rules.

features.name: AI client questionnaires mapped to documents
features.where: Questionnaires > Questionnaire Templates > Create; Live Questionnaires
features.what: AI writes plain-language questions from the required fields of chosen forms/templates; share link per matter; statuses Not started, In progress, Needs review, Completed; firm reviews then saves answers to matter.

features.name: Draft from forms and templates inside Vincent
features.where: Vincent > Draft > Draft documents from forms and templates
features.what: Vincent gathers case facts, flags conflicting or missing facts and role assignment before generating forms/templates.

features.name: e-Signature (Dropbox Sign integration)
features.where: Documents > Download arrow > e-Sign
features.what: PDF only (40 MB / 500 pages); signer must be a contact with email; sequential signing optional; drag signature, initials, date fields; included at no extra cost but usable only inside Clio.
features.plan_tier: Unlimited on Advanced/Expand (CA) and Grow; Essentials 15 per user/month pooled; EasyStart 3 per user/month pooled; no rollover

features.name: e-Signature limits counter
features.where: Documents > e-Sign dialog
features.what: Shows remaining monthly signatures on capped plans.

features.name: Cancel / remind via Dropbox Sign account
features.where: Dropbox Sign web app
features.what: Requests cannot be cancelled inside Clio; cancel or remind in Dropbox Sign; automatic reminders at 3 and 7 days; sender email text not customizable.

features.name: Clio Grow PDF templates with signature fields and conditional fields
features.where: Grow > Documents > Templates > Create New > PDF Template
features.what: Drag signature, initials, date signed, name, email, textbox, checkbox, dropdown, radio; rules show/hide fields based on a checkbox; firm users can sign before client; due dates, auto reminders, resend expired links.

features.name: Clio Draft built-in e-sign (US only)
features.where: Draft > Signatures
features.what: US customers use Draft's own e-sign tool; Canadian customers are pointed to the Dropbox Sign integration in Manage.

features.name: DocuSign integration (US only)
features.where: Documents > e-Sign (DocuSign)
features.what: Optional DocuSign connection; signed copy is emailed back and must be added as a new version manually.

features.name: Share via secure link, client portal, co-counsel portal, internal direct link
features.where: Documents > Actions > Share > Share externally
features.what: Secure email link (no login), Clio for Clients portal, Clio for Co-Counsel portal, internal copy-link for users with matter permission.
features.plan_tier: portal on Essentials+ per third-party tier lists (unverified)

features.name: Folder share auto-includes later files; client upload folder
features.where: Matter > Documents > folder > Share to client portal
features.what: Files added later to a shared folder are shared automatically; firms make a 'Client uploads' folder; 100 MB portal upload cap; passwordless email login (1-hour link).

features.name: Co-counsel sharing with 7-day email links
features.where: Documents > Share with contacts > Share via Clio for Co-Counsel
features.what: External attorneys see shared items until unshared; notification links expire after 7 days; reshare by stop and share again.

features.name: AI Document Analyzer
features.where: AI Launchpad (diamond) > Analyze Documents; document Actions > Analyze with Vincent
features.what: Up to 25 DOCX/TXT/PDF files, 50 MB total; summary or thorough; matter documents only; no follow-up context across sessions.

features.name: AI schedule events from documents
features.where: AI Launchpad; Matter dashboard AI Actions; Calendar > New event > Extract from a document
features.what: Classifies document type, extracts dates (including handwritten notes) into events for review; does not apply local court day-counting rules.

features.name: AI data processing location and opt-out
features.where: Settings > Account Level AI Access
features.what: AI queries may be processed outside the firm's home jurisdiction; results stored in region; admin can switch AI off firm-wide, which also removes content search.

features.name: Tabular Document Review
features.where: Work > Vincent > Analyze > Tabular Document Review
features.what: One row per document, one column per question; Vincent fills cells; templates of tables can be saved.

features.name: Compare documents / redline analysis
features.where: Vincent > More Workflows > Compare Documents; Redline Analysis
features.what: Side-by-side comparison of two documents (versions or opposing filings) with relationship note and synthesis; redline analysis for docx/pdf.

features.name: Translate documents
features.where: Vincent workflow
features.what: AI translation of documents.

features.name: Clio for Word add-in (Vincent in Word)
features.where: Word > Home > Add-ins > Clio for Microsoft Word
features.what: Vincent drafts and revises in Word as native tracked changes or direct edits; save back to Clio by normal upload.
features.plan_tier: Clio Work / Vincent for Enterprise; template builder with Clio Draft

features.name: Mobile scan to PDF
features.where: + > Document > Scan documents
features.what: Camera scan with crop, multi-page into one PDF, filed to matter folder with category.

features.name: Automated email filing and Maildrop
features.where: Settings > Communications > Connect your inbox; Matter > Communications > Copy matter Maildrop address
features.what: Connect Gmail/Outlook/Exchange to auto-file contact emails to matters; per-matter forwarding address saves EML (forward method cannot upload attachments).

features.name: OneDrive for Business sync
features.where: Settings > Apps > Microsoft > OneDrive for Business
features.what: One firm account; Clio builds client/matter folder tree in OneDrive; renaming those folders in OneDrive causes re-creation.

features.name: Clio Draft separate account, seats and products
features.where: Clio Draft > Settings > Subscription
features.what: Separate per-seat subscription with selectable products (court forms, document automation); Chrome-only for full function; single active session, 24h inactivity logout.
features.plan_tier: Draft add-on (USD list approx. $99/user/month per search snippet; CAD unverified)

gaps.proposal: Add field locked_by + locked_at on Document and actions Lock / Unlock (unlock by locker or admin). Agent auto-locks a document while it is drafting a new version and releases on save; a human edit on a locked doc offers 'branch as new version'.

gaps.feature: Status, classification, tags, received date on documents
gaps.proposal: Add fields status (draft | in review | final | sent | signed), classification (legal type, agent-proposed), tags (max 10), received_at (date the firm received it, distinct from upload time; agent extracts from stamps/emails). received_at feeds limitation and service deadlines.

gaps.feature: Saved filter views and configurable columns
gaps.proposal: Add filters (type, status, classification, uploader, tags, category, privilege) and Save view; per-user column picker. AI: natural-language filter ('unsigned engagement letters this month') compiles to a saved view.

Add a /documents/firm library (precedent-adjacent firm material, policies) and a per-user Private drafts area; moving a private draft into a matter triggers G-D1 filing checks. Keep admin-blind rule: firm admin sees no matter files.
Add a History tab: uploads, versions, views, shares, signature events, agent reads (which agent job read it and why). Agent reads are our differentiator for audit.
On ingest, extract Word comments and tracked changes into a read-only 'From file' comments block alongside firm comments.
Add action 'Create PDF' (new document linked to source version hash). Signature-request already converts; make it a first-class action.

gaps.feature: Bundle with cover page, TOC, page numbers, matter footer
gaps.proposal: Add matter_number_footer option and cover fields (title, code, date) to match; keep index/tabs.

gaps.feature: Generate document on matter created / stage change
gaps.proposal: Add assembly triggers: on matter open or stage change (practice area, responsible lawyer, from/to stage) -> agent generates the set into target_folder and routes to G8. Coordinate with matters area stage model.

gaps.feature: Court form library with official-version tracking (ON first)
gaps.proposal: Add a Court forms tab: official Ontario forms (Rules of Civil Procedure, Family Law Rules, Estates) with source URL, version date and checksum; a daily job detects new official versions and flags firm form templates built on old versions (Clio does not auto-update form templates). 'Request a form' -> internal backlog.

gaps.feature: Pre-filled form templates and reusable sets
gaps.proposal: Confirm a Set entity (up to N items, practice-area tagged) and form-template prefill; one populate step across the set.

gaps.feature: Client questionnaire generated from document fields
gaps.proposal: Action 'Ask client for missing answers': agent builds a questionnaire only for unresolved fields of the selected template/set, sends a portal link, tracks Not started / In progress / Needs review / Completed; reviewed answers save to matter facts (with source = client) before Generate. Coordinate with intake area.
Before Generate, show a 'case facts' panel listing missing, conflicting (two sources disagree, each cited) and role-unassigned fields; Generate blocked until resolved.
Add template status needs-review | in-progress | ready before G-D2 publish; Propose fields output lists each field and condition with the source text span.
Keep: share a folder only as a live view of G8-approved items; new files in a shared folder are queued for G8 rather than auto-shared. State this rule explicitly on the screen.
Add recipient_kind (client | co-counsel | opposing) with co-counsel two-way upload folder and stop-sharing; links expire (Clio uses 7 days).
Add mode 'table': user or agent defines columns; one row per document; every cell cites page:line; export CSV; save table as template.
Extend Compare versions to compare any two documents: topic table with cited positions from each, plus material-difference summary.
Action 'Translate (EN<->FR first)': produces a linked translated copy marked 'machine translation, unverified' until a person approves.
Document row action 'Add time' prefilled with document and matter; agent proposes time from edit sessions on the document.

Keep web-first; answer the open question with an evidence note: Clio ships Drive (two-way sync), Launcher and Clio for Word with AI tracked changes. Minimum: 'Open in Word' via WebDAV-style check-out using the lock above.
Mobile-web capture: camera pages -> one PDF -> ingest-document (OCR, classify, file).
Add revise mode tracked | direct; tracked mode outputs accept/reject redlines, each change carrying its reason and citation.
Ours voids inside the app (Clio cannot cancel inside Clio). No caps. Keep as differentiator; add reminder defaults 3 and 7 days for parity.
field_types already lists conditional display; add rule format 'show field X when checkbox Y checked'.

corrections.our_claim: documents.json clio_gaps: 'Full text search ... Clio native OCR unclear' (implies Clio full-text search is always on)
corrections.truth: Clio global search covers full-text content only when AI features are enabled; if the firm opts out, search is names and metadata only. No Clio article describes OCR of scanned images in Manage, so 'OCR unclear' stays unproven.

corrections.our_claim: documents.json sources cite clio.com/ca/draft/e-signatures, implying Clio Draft e-sign is available in Canada
corrections.truth: Draft's built-in e-sign is described as US-only; Canadian customers are pointed to the Dropbox Sign integration in Manage/Grow.

corrections.our_claim: documents.json clio_gaps: 'Clio Draft: court forms ... Ontario court forms in templates' (implies Clio has Ontario court forms)
corrections.truth: Clio's own sources conflict: one help article lists US plus Ontario and BC forms, another lists only BC in Canada. The launch press release covers Canadian court forms and document automation in all provinces except Quebec, hosted in Canada. Treat Ontario court-form coverage as unconfirmed.

corrections.our_claim: documents.json clio_gaps: 'Version history, only newest deletable'
corrections.truth: Not found in the version, delete or manage articles read; only confirmed: upload new version, download any version, permanent delete removes all versions. Mark unproven.

corrections.our_claim: documents.json clio_gaps: 'e-Signature ... link expiry' and our default 14 days
corrections.truth: Clio is not consistent: Grow says signature links are valid for 7 days (resendable), and another passage says 14 days. Manage e-sign goes through Dropbox Sign, which sends automatic reminders at 3 and 7 days.

Defensible but should be more precise: Vincent in Clio Work gives cited analysis; the Manage Document Analyzer (no Work) shows no citations in its help. Suggest wording: 'cited in Clio Work (Vincent), not in base Manage AI'.

corrections.our_claim: versus page: 'Data: AI may process outside Canada'
corrections.truth: Confirmed by Clio: AI features may process queries on servers outside the firm's home jurisdiction; results are stored in region. Clio Draft Canada court forms are hosted in Canada. Keep the claim and cite it.

corrections.our_claim: versus page: 'Mobile apps, Outlook and Gmail add-ins'
corrections.truth: Outlook add-in and mobile app confirmed. A Gmail add-in was not checked in this scope; email filing connects Gmail through automated email filing instead. Verify before publishing.
